title: George Guesnon joins the band after Marrero's illness
summary: Guesnon replaces the sick Marrero around the Boston trip and the Paramount restaurant, and plays on a Blue Note record.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money

blocks.x: So I said, well I'll give up this, this parade business and let's stick to my other jobs. I ain't fooling that no more. Yeah. Tell you something I was going to ask you, how George Gaino come into the band. Well George Gaino got into the band by way of Lawrence Morero.
When Lawrence was taken sick and we had to go to Boston.
Well we had to send for him.
Mm-hmm. He was about the best, was he, at that time?

Yeah. And we was playing at Charles Paramount. Yeah. We had went to Boston and we came back to Charles, Charles, Charles Paramount restaurant. Yeah. And that's where Gaino finished playing out with us there.
Mm-hmm. And the record you made, you know, with George on that.
Uh, Blue Note? Blue Note, yeah. Well George was on that. Yeah. Yeah, George.
You like making that record? Yeah. It was George, the way George was playing was different from Lawrence, but I mean, did it affect you much?
No, it didn't worry me at all. I like, I enjoy this playing. You played the same sort of way. Yeah, I didn't change my type, my type of playing. I just kept the same old method.
And he looked like he was enjoying my drumming himself.
